name: signaltech-x-ultra-player-two-rest-look-three-reveal-ally-rest-bottom-sacrifice
notes: PLAYER 2 seating (perspective check) for SignalTech X Ultra (vFvhZeunOc): player 1's pass opens a response window in which player 2 activates it; the same reveal as the player 1 fixture on player 2's deck.

rulesClauses: [REST]: Look at the top three cards of your deck. You may reveal an ally card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order. If a card was put into your hand this way, sacrifice SignalTech X Ultra.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Three defects in the generated SignalTech X Ultra / Lucia pair plus the shared ResolveTopDeckOptionalSelection() (GameLogic.php). (1) The helper put the 'rest' on the bottom with a loop of MZMove($player, "myDeck-0", "myDeck"): Remove() only flags a slot removed (no splice), so "myDeck-0" resolved to the SAME removed slot on every iteration after the first and MZMove's "already removed" guard silently no-oped: only ONE of the looked-at cards ever went to the bottom (live repro on HEAD, no candidate: only the top card moved to the bottom, the rest stayed on top). Fixed with MZMoveTopOfZone() plus a trailing CleanupRemovedCards(). (2) The generated follow-up handler passed an UNDEFINED $topCount to the helper (the variable only exists in the other closure), so after a reveal the remaining count was 0 and NOTHING at all was put on the bottom (live repro: the ally taken, the other cards stayed on top of the deck). (3) The follow-up was queued without dontSkipOnPass, so declining the optional reveal (MZMAYCHOOSE answered PASS) skipped it and the looked-at cards were never put on the bottom. (2) and (3) live in generated closures (gitignored), so both closures are overridden in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php: the look count is carried in the TopDeckOptionalCount decision-queue variable and the follow-up is queued with dontSkipOnPass:1.
